mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SHIPPING_REQUESTS (ORDER_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, STATUS) SELECT DISTINCT o.ORDER_ID, o.CUSTOMER_ID, 'READY' FROM ORDERS o JOIN ORDER_ITEMS i ON i.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID JOIN CUSTOMERS c ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = o.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE o.PROCESSED = 0

INSERT INTO SHIPMENTS (ORDER_ID, SHIPPED_AT) SELECT DISTINCT r.ORDER_ID, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM SHIPPING_REQUESTS r JOIN ORDER_ITEMS i ON i.ORDER_ID = r.ORDER_ID JOIN INVENTORY v ON v.PRODUCT_ID = i.PRODUCT_ID WHERE r.STATUS = 'READY' AND v.QUANTITY > 0
mapper.update: UPDATE SHIPPING_REQUESTS SET STATUS = 'SHIPPED' WHERE ORDER_ID IN (SELECT ORDER_ID FROM SHIPMENTS)
UPDATE SHIPMENTS SET SHIPPED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE SHIPPED_AT IS NULL
